final: SELECT (SELECT AVG(invoice_mean_price) FROM (SELECT AVG(ili.product_price) AS invoice_mean_price FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number)) AS average_invoice_mean_line_item_price, (SELECT AVG(line_item_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number)) AS average_line_items_per_invoice
